publishedContributions.text: Those “million little ones” are the real browser UX. If tabs, shortcuts and DevTools keep breaking expectations, each surprise compounds over a workday. Which shortcut or tab behavior was the final straw?

Useful if it distinguishes background from idle. A render, upload or call can keep working after you switch windows. Would you exempt active media/capture or let people mark an app as never throttled? That’s the boundary I’d want to test.
